utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in for the repair drive, Dane. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can take the hauling and cleanup. Tell me what’s left and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That helps a lot, thanks. I’ll line up the rest and tell you what’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the drive. What still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me check what’s left first: the wiring and the loose mount were still acting up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it. I can help with those two next.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what we still need for the repair drive and keep an eye on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that helps. I’ll keep track of it too, just in case I miss something.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then we’ll compare notes and make sure nothing slips through.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about it, but I haven’t had the full story yet. How’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It’s moving, but I’m still sorting out the logistics. We’re short on hands for the heavier repairs, so I’m trying to keep the schedule from getting messy.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can swing by and help with the heavier repairs if that would make the schedule easier to keep.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s left on the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think the big stuff is still the roof patch and the front steps. If you can bring a ladder and a few tools, I can help sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can bring the ladder and tools. What kind of tools do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up steam today. Folks are dropping off tools and supplies over by the hall.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds like a good turnout. I’ve got a couple spare wrenches and a drill if the hall needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That'll be a big help, Gus. I’ll tell them to keep an eye out for your wrench and drill when they’re sorting donations at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re meeting at my place at six for the repair drive, and I’ve already told a few neighbors to come by. Want me to put your name on the list?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, put my name on the list. I’ll be there at six.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, you’re on the list. I’ll see you at six.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirm the repair drive is still on, and let me know what time you want me there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, the repair drive is still on. I can be there at 6:00 if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll keep us moving one house at a time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just point me to the first house.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The first stop is the Martinez place on Maple. I’ll hand you the address and what they need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can keep that moving. I’ll repeat the plan to Eli and make sure we’re set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep repeating it to Eli and make sure the repair drive stays on track.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I was meaning to bring by my wrench set - did I already say that?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: No, you just mentioned it. Thanks, though.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sorry, I keep losing track of this stuff, but I’ll grab the wrench set and bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules. We mainly need help spreading the word and bringing any tools or supplies you can spare.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and I’ll bring along a few tools and supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive's happening, and I'm telling folks to swing by if they can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I can swing by late and help out for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll let the others know you’re coming by late. We can use all the hands we can get.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about it. Tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I just need a hand loading the boxes and keeping the list checked off. If you can come by at nine, that would help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can be there at nine and help load the boxes and keep the list checked off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around that after pickup, if that works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me. I’ll be there after pickup and we can coordinate then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you after pickup then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for helping organize this, Vik. I can ask around and connect anyone who wants to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and line up anyone who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll keep reaching out and make sure anyone who wants to help has a way in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a drill and a ladder you can borrow if it helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, but I should probably check the schedule first so we don’t end up with too much to haul at once.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That makes sense. I can hold onto the ladder and drill until you’ve got the schedule sorted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of the location if you tell me where the repair drive is headed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s headed to Maple Street, by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll note Maple Street by the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The repair drive is still on, right? What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still on. Just bring the toolkit and the replacement screws, please.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, I’ll bring those.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Cleo. Tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a short list: the fence gate, the porch light, and the loose step by my door.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, that’s a clear list. I can start with the fence gate and the porch light, then take a look at the loose step by your door.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive got started, but I’m only getting bits and pieces. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it’s underway, but I only caught part of it. They’ve started the drive and are sorting repairs now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like they’re just getting started then. Did they say which repairs are first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess, you mean the repair drive is still on for today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on for today. I’m hearing folks are already getting things set up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure — I’ll keep an eye out for it then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is getting some momentum. I can swing by after errands and see what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I’d appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing. I’ll stop by after I’m done and check what still needs attention.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring something for it, but I’m a little scattered today. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring whatever you’ve got for the fixes. I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, I’ve got a few odds and ends I can bring by.
